_comment: The nine natural-trigger prompts of evals/40 to 72. Each prompt names no skill. skill is the one that should be the best match in the listing; intent is the ork:auto category that should route the same prompt to it (null when the skill is outside the routes this test pins). known_gap marks a prompt the skill does not actually cover: it is reported as SKIP with the reason, never counted as a pass. Offline: no model call, no spend.

cases.known_gap: asks for exact bisect commands between two release tags; fix-issue finds the introducing commit by blame inside a root-cause pass and has no bisect step, so no honest listing wording makes it the best match

asks which branch flow gets a hotfix to production; create-pr opens a PR against the remote's default base and has no hotfix or promote flow, so no listing wording can honestly route this prompt to it
